summary_1line: Yudhishthira organizes the Pandava army with seven commanders while Balarama visits, predicts massive slaughter, and chooses neutrality by departing on pilgrimage.

image_candidates.scene_text: Balarama in blue silk, surrounded by Vrishni warriors, enters the Pandava camp as kings rise to honor him.
Yudhishthira formally appoints seven warriors as commanders before the gathered Pandava army.
Balarama solemnly declares the coming battlefield will be a mire of flesh and blood before leaving for the Saraswati pilgrimage.
